description: Resource schema for AWS::WellArchitected::AgentContext. An Agent Context provides supplemental application context (free-form content) within an Agent Profile, used to improve the quality of Well-Architected Agent recommendations.

ContextType.description: The type of the Agent Context.
ContextType.markdownDescription:
The type of the Agent Context.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: APPLICATION  
Update requires: No interruption

ApplicationType.description: Type of the application described by this context. Mirrors the value stored in `Content.applicationType` and is surfaced as a typed read-only attribute by the service for discoverability.
ApplicationType.markdownDescription:
Type of the application described by this context. Mirrors the value stored in `Content.applicationType` and is surfaced as a typed read-only attribute by the service for discoverability.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: SAS | DESKTOP_APPLICATION | OTHER  
Update requires: No interruption

Criticality.description: Business criticality of the application described by this context. Mirrors the value stored in `Content.criticality` and is surfaced as a typed read-only attribute by the service for discoverability.
Criticality.markdownDescription:
Business criticality of the application described by this context. Mirrors the value stored in `Content.criticality` and is surfaced as a typed read-only attribute by the service for discoverability.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: MISSION_CRITICAL | BUSINESS_CRITICAL | NON_CRITICAL | TEST_DEVELOPMENT  
Update requires: No interruption

Arn.description: The synthetic Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Context, composed of the parent profile ARN and the context id.
Arn.markdownDescription:
The synthetic Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Agent Context, composed of the parent profile ARN and the context id.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 2048  
Pattern: ^arn:aws([a-z0-9-]+)?:wellarchitected:[a-z0-9-]{6,64}:[0-9]{12}:agent-profile/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/agent-context/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

ProfileArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the parent Agent Profile that owns this context. Pass `!Ref` of the parent AWS::WellArchitected::AgentProfile to flow its ARN here.
